title: Pope Leo criticises Milei’s austerity in Argentina, says growth must benefit all
paragraphs: Pope Leo criticises Milei’s austerity in Argentina, says growth must benefit all

Pope Leo XIV arrived in Argentina on Sunday from Uruguay, where his Latin America tour began, facing calls to help bridge divisions after three years of austerity under President Javier Milei. The visit to Buenos Aires is the first by a pontiff to the late Pope Francis’s homeland in nearly four decades.
Pope Leo XIV delivered a stinging critique of President Javier Milei's harsh austerity measures Sunday, insisting growth must benefit all in a speech met with rapturous applause.
